description: This file defines a controller class 'Filter' for the OpenCart administration panel, responsible for rendering and handling interactions related to a module called 'filter'. It includes methods for displaying the filter configuration page ('index') and saving configuration settings ('save').

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A controller class extending the core Controller, managing the module's configuration interface in the admin area for the 'filter' module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the module configuration page with breadcrumbs and module status.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the module settings after verifying user permissions and returns a JSON response.
